summary: Two simulated parallel pull requests from this branch each start a session, add and run a case in their own cases file, note one shared bug, pause and resume, rebuild the vault, append a ledger line and add a CHANGELOG bullet. Without the Chough drivers configured, git merge-tree reports one conflict, the shared bug record. With them, git merge is clean: both bug notes, both case files and both sessions are kept, and library index --check reports the vault stale until chough library index rebuilds it.
provenance: unauthenticated observation; not proof of human approval, test execution, or deployment
limitations: Spec change logs and requirements.md still conflict until CorvidLabs/spec-sync#862.
